content: Tagadatag nǝ Yesu kǝ ǝlbǝg tǝghǝr kǝ dlǝga vǝgya Daadamazhigǝla
Tǝɗuula Sagal nǝ Yesu ma vǝgya Daadamazhigǝla, am pal ma mbǝrzahaan taa kǝ iina, “Dadda tsagga dǝgita, vazǝg kǝ maandala akurahaan ard ndǝrgahaana, dǝgaha jappǝra!”
Am Yesu taa kǝ iina, “Agha nǝghǝganǝghǝg kǝ maandala hǝnyahahaana? Da dlagav baɗǝmma. Da maay ɗuwav nǝ akur aanji pal tǝghǝr kǝ zǝraabaan biya.”
Dlaɗa Zǝngngwa
Cihurgan nǝ Yesu tǝ Aghwa Zaitun kwar vazakav magyimagyi dǝ Vǝgya Daadamazhigǝla, kaa ndavgarundavǝg kǝ Bitrusa, Yakuba, Yuhwana, ard Andrawus ba daghuvaatǝr taakiya,
“Tagkǝmndtaga, da dzǝgaar hǝr wanahaan kǝ dǝgitahi? Au nǝ dǝga sǝrgi da nǝghǝvaaka nǝ iin tǝ vakai akwama hǝrz sarta dzǝgardzǝgaani?”
Aiyam Yesu taa kǝ iitǝra, “Famfǝg kǝ hyǝmiya, aa valkurdai nǝ uudah biya.
Uudah baɗyak ar da sagau ma ɗaagara, ar da taakiya, ‘Kai nǝ iina,’ ar da valtǝrda kǝ uudah baɗyaka.
Akwama cinngamacinnga kǝ ǝlbǝga ghwaava ard dlaghalgaana, gǝdzam biya. Barari da dzǝgardzǝg wanahaana, bakǝvakwaha ghaalaan ndakwani sǝghǝv bi ndan biya.

Uudaha kǝssi tlǝrna, ar da dǝgaradǝg kǝ uudaha kǝssi tlǝrǝn dǝ ghwaava, kwarga ar da ɓa ghwaav dǝ kwarga. Da gajagav nǝ haay vakavak shahshaha, da mǝng baz waiya. Baɗǝm wanahaana iin bi gyigyiya dlaɗiin biya. Ba fǝgarzhaana.

Famfǝg kǝ hyimmi tǝ ghǝraharuwa, aɗaba da langkurlang nǝ uuda damma guda shariya, da kalkuraaka nǝ uud ma guda dzahava Yahudaha. Da langkurlang nǝ uud da tǝvuukwa tlǝvuukwaha ard tlǝkǝsaha mbakyarvad dǝ ɗaagara, am da tagǝda kǝ shiid maraw tǝghǝr kǝskai tǝvuukwatǝra.
Lakuti sagau nǝ halavuwaana, barari tagǝvtǝra nǝ ǝlbǝg maraw kǝ uudaha duni baɗǝma.

Ba kǝlaa sarti viikurǝt nǝ uuda, akwama dakurdaadǝg da vaka ta shariya, ndavambi kǝ dǝgiti am da tag nǝ uuram biya. Ndzaa ba tagamtag kǝ dǝgi da vǝlkur nǝ Daadamazhigǝl ma kwahiin kǝ sarta, aɗaba kurambi wa taaghaiy biya, Shǝɗǝkwa Daadamazhigǝla.
Zǝraaba da vǝlda kǝ zǝraabaan da tsǝvana, daad dlaɓa da vǝlda kǝ zǝraana. Zarh dlaɓ ar da ciyarant kǝ yaatǝra kwa da fǝgara cǝɓǝvtǝra nǝ yaatǝra.
Baɗǝm nǝ uudaha ar da naakur bi mbakyarvad ɗaagar biya, Baɗǝm nǝ daddakwa ghacaghacǝg dat ghalaana, da katavva.”
Dlaɗa Ba Vaivaiya

“Akwama nǝghamanaghǝg kǝ dǝgit dzah ma vǝgya Daadamazhigǝla, kwada fǝgara uudah kǝ ɗuwa vakavakina, (Aa nǝghaakanǝghǝg dadda karantǝgaan taakiya) lii ma larda Yahudiya aa ǝmdǝrarǝmdǝrǝg dagat damma aghwaha.
Kwa tǝ ghǝragud dlaɓa, aa sǝbbi saay samma hǝnyah da kǝssa dǝgit biya.”
Dadda kwama guh dlaɓa, aa sǝbi saasa hǝnyah da kǝssa sǝɗavan biya.
Dǝga zhuwadaal kǝ ǝnghwasahi ǝnhuɗa ard lii dǝ zǝr ma dlaaga ma kwanǝn kǝ sarta!
Dzǝgwamdzǝg kǝ zhigǝl aa dzaarbi wanahaan kǝ dǝgitah ma sarta viyakǝsa biya.

Ma kwahiin kǝ sarta, da hǝɓav dlaɗ ba vaivai kwa tapavǝnabi kǝ hǝɓgaan ciigǝt ma sarta kwa vǝrɗya nǝ Daadamazhigǝl kǝ duni biya, tangw damma kwanǝn kǝ sarta. Da maadlai gwiya dzǝgardzǝg hulfa kwan kǝ dlaɗ ba dǝm biya.
Maa maay kwakyarvad gulghanigulǝg nǝ Yaazhigǝl kǝ hǝngahin biya, maa maay nǝ uuda dǝgshigi da ngǝdlǝg biya. Mbakyarvad uudahaan dzǝrghaaka nǝ iina, kaa gulǝnagulǝg kǝ iin kǝ hǝngaha.
“Ma kwahin kǝ sarta baɗǝm daddakwa tagkur taakiya, ‘Vazǝga, wai nǝ Kǝristi vaakwana!’ bi, ‘Vazǝg, wai nǝ iin vaakwaha!’ Haiyamant biya.
Aɗaba kǝristiya fiidfiida ard tlayangaha fiidfiida ar da sagala, ar da ɓa dǝga sǝrǝga ard dǝgaha jappǝrha, kiyava vala uudaha, akwama ɓagaɓaga, baz lii dzǝravtǝraakadzǝrga.
Mbakyarvad kwaha famfǝg kǝ hyǝmiya! Tagankuratag kǝ dǝgitah baɗǝm bamma sarta.”
Saaya Zǝra Uuda.
“Aiciya, ma kwahiin kǝ sarta, tǝhala dlaɗǝn da sagauna,

content.text: Kyil dlaɓa da maay ɓa parakrak biya.
Kwadladlah ar da ɓala saay ma ghǝrazhigǝla.
Da gajagav nǝ dǝgitahi ɗyakɗyak tǝ zhigǝla.’

content: “Tǝhala kwaha da nǝghǝvanǝghǝg Zǝra Uud saay ma akumba dǝ ndzǝɗa ard ndanggǝra.
Tǝhala kwaha da bǝldi kǝ zǝrɓǝlǝgahaan ar da dzahant kǝ lii dzǝrghaaka nǝ iin sagatsǝga, ard dagatdǝga, ard dagaldǝga ard saadǝsǝga, cigǝt tǝ ngyilla duniya dat ghaala zhigǝla.
Tsag Tǝghǝr Kǝ Uufa Ghǝgiva
“Tsagamtsag kǝ ndzǝgana uufa ghǝgiva. Akwama fǝgharzhafǝg nǝ dǝvahaan kǝ ɓa ndaɗa, dlaɓa farzha kǝ ɗa daala hyǝmiya, sǝramasǝrǝg taakiya hǝrz nǝ madara.
Bandkwah dlaɓ akwama nǝghamanǝghǝg kwanahaan kǝ dǝgitah dzǝgaardzǝga, sǝramasǝrǝg taakiya hǝrz sarta, ba hɛɛf dǝ ghaiya wakyagha.
Bak jiijiira wan tagkurtaga, uudaha kwanǝn kǝ zamana ar da maay ǝmtsǝg biya, bamma dzǝghardzǝg wanahaan kǝ dǝgitah baɗǝmma.
Ghǝrazhigǝla ard haaya ar da ghyǝnga, ǝlbǝgara badǝmma da maay ghyǝng biya.
Maay Wa Sǝrgasǝrǝg kǝ faci bi sart biya
“Kwan kǝ faciya ard sarta Maay wa sǝrgasǝrǝg biya, aanji, zǝrɓǝlgahi ma ghǝrazhigǝla, aanji Zǝriina, bamma Daad palla.
Famfǝg kǝ hyǝmiya, am ɓadlǝvǝghana, aɗaba am sǝrga bi kǝ faciya ard sarti da dzǝgaar wanǝn biya.
Band uudi kwa tǝghǝrdǝga dagala, akwama ɗuugharsɗug kǝ hǝnyaha fǝtǝrdǝm ma dǝv kǝ ɛɛvahaana, ma kwaratǝr bad tlǝri da ɓag nǝ iina. Tǝhalakwaha tagar kǝ dadda uuffa hǝnyaha taakiya aa ɓadlǝvaɓadlǝgga.
Mbakyarvad kwaha, ndzamandzǝg ba ɓadlaɓadlana, aɗaba am sǝrgabi kǝ sarti da saas daddahǝnyah biya, ma da saa dǝghwaasa, ma mahuɗa vǝɗɗa, bi sarta wiiga ghwatǝkala, bi dlakadur ba wurra.
Aa da tlǝkuraabi gahragw am hǝnahaar biya.
Dǝginǝn ǝn tagkur naina, ǝn tagtǝr kǝ uudah baɗǝma, ‘Ndzamandzǝg ba ɓadlaɓadlana!’ ”
